name: Yohimbine
description: Alkaloid from the bark of the African yohimbe tree; an alpha-adrenergic receptor blocker

status.usStatus: Not FDA approved · bark sold as supplement

note.text: All were yohimbine hydrochloride tablets, before PDE5 drugs were approved. No trial of yohimbe supplements for ED was found.

bullets: **Blocks alpha-adrenergic receptors**, part of the nervous system that controls vessels
That action is the **basis for its study** in erectile dysfunction
**Bark supplements** may not act like the drug; their yohimbine content varies widely
No trial of yohimbe supplements for ED

practical.soldAs: Dietary supplement (yohimbe bark); no FDA-approved product

regulatory.text: Not approved; OTC aphrodisiac claims barred

references: NCCIH (NIH), Yohimbe: usefulness and safety, May 2025
eCFR, 21 CFR 310.528, OTC aphrodisiac drug products, Nov 2026
J Urol, Ernst & Pittler, yohimbine meta-analysis, Feb 1998
